Radwan Abdulhadi / رضوان عبد الهادي — Software Developer
Official website: https://rdwan.dev/
GitHub: https://github.com/rad03i2

TECHNICAL CONTENT

ARTICLE — Building Smart File Manager with C# and WinUI 3
Page: https://rdwan.dev/blog/smart-file-manager-csharp-winui3.html
Summary: Technical article about a Windows desktop project built with C#, .NET 8, WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK. It covers safe batch rename previews, prefix/suffix/numbering/text replacement, and duplicate detection by grouping files by size before SHA-256 hashing.
Related project: https://rdwan.dev/projects/01-smart-file-manager.html
Repository: https://github.com/rad03i2/SmartFileManager

ARTICLE — Robotics Language Lab: multi-language robotics learning lab
Page: https://rdwan.dev/blog/robotics-language-lab-multi-language.html
Summary: Technical article about organizing robotics examples across Python, C++, C, Arduino, MicroPython, ROS 2-style configuration, URDF, Go telemetry, JavaScript/TypeScript dashboards and C# diagnostics. The repository is explicitly a learning lab rather than a production robot stack.
Related project: https://rdwan.dev/projects/02-robotics-language-lab.html
Repository: https://github.com/rad03i2/robotics-language-lab

ARTICLE — Arabic RTL UI Components
Page: https://rdwan.dev/blog/arabic-rtl-ui-components.html
Summary: Technical article about reusable Arabic right-to-left UI components using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, including navigation, statistic cards, forms, alerts, responsive dashboard layouts and logical CSS properties.
Related project: https://rdwan.dev/projects/08-arabic-ui-components.html
Repository: https://github.com/rad03i2/arabic-ui-components

TECH NOTE — Duplicate files: size first, then SHA-256
Page: https://rdwan.dev/notes/duplicate-files-size-then-sha256.html
Summary: Explains a two-stage duplicate-file detection strategy: group files by byte size first, then compute SHA-256 only for groups containing multiple candidates.
Related project: https://rdwan.dev/projects/01-smart-file-manager.html
